mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause hypocalcemia and electrolyte disturbances, while minoxidil causes systemic vasodilation and can worsen fluid retention and electrolyte imbalances, increasing cardiovascular and metabolic complications.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), blood pressure, and cardiac function closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider alternative agents if significant electrolyte abnormalities develop.
